name: csv-to-json-converter
description: A script that reads a CSV file and converts it to a JSON file.

variants.javascript-no-comments: Write a JavaScript script that converts a CSV file to a JSON file. The script should be a function that takes a path to a CSV file as input and writes a JSON file with the same name (but a .json extension) in the same directory. The first line of the CSV should be the headers. The script should not have any comments.
variants.javascript-inline-comments: Write a JavaScript script that converts a CSV file to a JSON file. The script should be a function that takes a path to a CSV file as input and writes a JSON file with the same name (but a .json extension) in the same directory. The first line of the CSV should be the headers. The script should include inline comments to explain the logic.

testCases.description: Test with a simple CSV file
testCases.test: const csvToJsonConverter = require('./csv-to-json-converter.js'); csvToJsonConverter(testFile); const jsonFile = testFile.replace('.csv', '.json'); const jsonContent = fs.readFileSync(jsonFile, 'utf-8'); const expectedJson = JSON.stringify([{name: 'john', age: '30'}, {name: 'jane', age: '25'}]); console.assert(jsonContent === expectedJson, 'JSON content should match expected');
